text:
incident-bot: ALERT: spike in p99 latency and paging I/O on cluster-gamma. error-rate up 6x last 12m, sustained KV cache evictions. auto-page events 14/min. provenance: cont-batch controller reports high max_num_seqs allocations. https://status.redwood.example/incident/INC-1761234 :rotating_light:

maria (oncall): on it. pulling metrics now. any deploys in last hour?

priya (runtime): saw a config roll earlier that bumped CONT_BATCH_MAX_NUM_SEQS from 64 -> 512 in canary for throughput tests. believed safe but not tested with long-seq workloads.

jordan (eng-sre): that explains the KV working set growth -> evictions -> cold KV page reads -> disk I/O spike. paging kills latency. customers on high-concurrency routes likely hit.

maria (oncall): assigning mitigation steps: 1) throttle canary traffic away from cluster-gamma 2) revert max_num_seqs to 64 3) enable eviction-rate-limit 4) monitor p99 and errors.

ops-bot: Routing rule updated: cluster-gamma -> reduced external LB weight from 40% -> 10% (cmd: `rbacctl set-weight cluster-gamma 10`).

priya (runtime): preparing hotfix. will patch config map and rollout with zero-downtime. patch: ```yaml
CONT_BATCH_MAX_NUM_SEQS: "64"
CONT_BATCH_MAX_BATCH_TOKENS: "8192"
EVICTION_THROTTLE: "true"
```

maria (oncall): go for it. signal when patch applied.

priya (runtime): applied patch to cluster-gamma namespace, triggered rolling restart of cont-batcher pods. kubectl output:
```
deployment/cont-batcher-rollout restarted 6/6 pods
pod/cont-batcher-abcde ready
```

jordan (eng-sre): seeing immediate drop in page I/O and p99 trending down. errors dropping from 4.2% -> 0.8% over 6m.

maria (oncall): customer impact check: CS, can you confirm affected tenants?

cs-rep: pulling list... affected tenants: corpX, vm-saas, analytics-team; most saw 5-18% increased request timeouts during 10:12-10:40 UTC. no data loss, but latencies > SLA for corpX. I've flagged corpX for priority outreach.

priya (runtime): enabling eviction-rate-limit at 0.3 to prevent future blowups; also temp lowering CONT_BATCH_MAX_BATCH_TOKENS to 4096 for the cluster. commands: `kubectl set env deployment/cont-batcher CONT_BATCH_MAX_BATCH_TOKENS=4096 --namespace=cluster-gamma`

maria (oncall): after mitigation, p99 baseline restored to pre-incident levels. marking incident as mitigated. leaving in monitoring for 30m.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigated -> monitoring. severity: Sev2. timeline & initial notes posted to /docs/incidents/INC-1761234-draft.

jordan (eng-sre): root cause phasing: unguarded config change increased per-batch sequence allocations causing KV cache working set to exceed pool sizing; eviction storms cascaded into disk paging; continuous batching controller didn't enforce hard upper bound for mixed-length workloads.

priya (runtime): immediate postmortem actions: add validation/guard for CONT_BATCH_MAX_NUM_SEQS on deploy, add load test with long-seq mix to canary pipeline, and add automated rollback threshold when paging I/O > X.

maria (oncall): on-call handoff in 20m to @ashish. leaving notes: revert done, routing reduced, monitoring ok. please escalate if p99 > 3x baseline.

ashish (oncall-next): ack, I'll be on watch. pls ping if anything slides back.

cs-rep: corpX notified via support ticket and will escalate to CSM if SLA credit required.

maria (oncall): quick follow-ups: - PR to limit max_num_seqs default to 128 across clusters - add alert: sustained eviction-rate > 5/min -> auto-throttle canary weight - scheduled postmortem tomorrow 11:00 UTC with runtime + sres + product.

jordan (eng-sre): adding notes to incident doc and tagging related config PRs.

priya (runtime): leaving kernel-level metrics and KV eviction logs here for postmortem: `s3://redwood-ops/incident-1761234/logs.tar.gz`.

incident-bot: INCIDENT CLOSED -> monitoring. final severity to be confirmed after postmortem. :white_check_mark:
